description_html:
Documentation

3D Model

Overview

The Triple-axis Tourbillon Model Components Kit contains all the necessary hardware components for assembling a Triple-axis Tourbillon Model. To complete the assembly for an entirely functional piece, users also need to download the model files and 3D print the remaining parts.
Creator Program: The Creator Program is a collaborative program between Bambu Lab and creators. Creators unleash their creativity to design 3D printing models, while Bambu Lab provides compatible hardware kits for those designs.
Model Creator Model Link

To download the model files of Triple-axis Tourbillon Model and obtain detailed information, please visit the Triple-axis Tourbillon Model on MakerWorld.
